stem: During harvest, one cart has a label discrepancy, another has visible foreign material, and the room is behind schedule. What is the strongest technician response?
choices: Control the identity and contamination deviations first, segregate affected material per procedure, document them, and continue unaffected work only where authorized
Combine all carts to recover schedule time
Ignore the foreign material because identity is more important
Relabel both carts from memory and finish the room
rationale: Schedule pressure does not override traceability or contamination controls. Deviations should be contained while unaffected work continues only within procedure.
